svg.text: One customer visit at Box 1 (cleaning), Box 2 (drying) or Box 3 (cleaning and drying), and everything behind the screens
BEHIND THE SCREENS: THE WHOLE SYSTEM
• Boxes: the boards of each box (A1, A2, A3 / C1, C2 / B1, B2, B3) and its sub-server (S3A / S3C / S3B) use the ESP-NOW radio, channel 1; no router is needed.
• ACS 1 and ACS 2: talk to the sub-server of Box 1 and Box 3 over ESP-NOW (refill request, level, done).
• LocalServer: the hub of the radio and its own Wi-Fi 'ESP32_LOCAL'; the Control Center opens in any phone or PC browser. All commands and settings go through it.
• Online Server: only listens to the radio and never sends a command; it joins a Wi-Fi chosen in its setup page to reach the internet.
• Online Server to Blynk: HTTPS update of one datastream (V0) about every minute; a second, public Blynk device carries only the customer status.
• Web page: static files kept in GitHub and published by Vercel; the page reads Blynk over HTTPS and sends nothing back (read-only).
• People: the admin changes things in the Control Center; the owner watches the Control Center and the web page; the customer uses the touch screen and the status page.
